# Bloggists

> Bloggists is a one-person SEO practice that builds search foundations for bloggers, Blogger.com sites, and small businesses, and publishes a daily curated roundup of 100 articles from across the web.

## Pages
- [Home](https://bloggists.com/): What Bloggists does and who it's for
- [Services & pricing](https://bloggists.com/services.html): SEO services, including the Sisyphus Starter package
- [Local SEO](https://bloggists.com/local-seo.html): Local SEO through a network of state-specific sites
- [About](https://bloggists.com/about.html): Our approach and platforms (Blogger.com specialists; WordPress, Wix, Squarespace, Shopify)
- [Contact](https://bloggists.com/contact.html): Start a project

## Roundups
- [All roundups](https://bloggists.com/roundups/): Daily curated lists of 100 articles worth reading
- [RSS feed](https://bloggists.com/roundups/feed.xml)
